# GET /static and GET /static/ are distinct ServeMux patterns, so their
# TemplateRoutePaths methods have distinct names: the subtree pattern, the one
# with the trailing slash, ends its name in Subtree when the exact pattern is
# also a route. Alone, GET /static/ is ReadStatic.

muxt generate
exec go test ./...

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /static"}}exact{{end}}
{{define "GET /static/"}}subtree{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- template_test.go --
package server

import "testing"

func TestRoutePaths(t *testing.T) {
	var paths TemplateRoutePaths
	if got, want := paths.ReadStatic(), "/static"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("ReadStatic() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if got, want := paths.ReadStaticSubtree(), "/static/"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("ReadStaticSubtree() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
